verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an authenticator app and its API, for example bulk export, edit or removal of tokens. The evidence documents only per-item actions such as editing accounts and renaming or removing devices. Community reports describe the opposite of bulk handling: no export option and migrations done a few entries at a time. Device sync and backup are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
